App display name changed from "Bulk Text Reply" to "Bulk SMS Reply Log" (folder/project also renamed to bulk-sms-reply-log-app; Android package ID com.georgeapp.bulksmsreply deliberately left unchanged for build safety)

Added read_locally column (DB version 1->2, with in-place ALTER TABLE migration) plus markThreadRead() and unreadNormalizedAddresses() - app-local "mark as read" feature; cannot write the phone's real SMS read flag since this app is not the default texting app

Calls messageLogDatabase.markThreadRead() after any bulk action is applied; tracks unreadNormalizedAddresses state and passes it to ConversationListScreen

Each log row now shows Read/Unread (in this app) status
Added "Unread only" filter chip, a "Select unread" shortcut button, and an on-behalf-of attribution label (falls back to the raw number) on each conversation row
Wired onSelectAllUnread callback (selects every conversation with unread messages)
Added signingConfigs.debug pointing at the repo-root debug.keystore and set buildTypes.debug.signingConfig to it, so debug builds (local or CI) always share one signature.

Added ProcessedConversation data class and processedConversations() - finds conversations whose CURRENT latest message already has an action recorded, so a new incoming text automatically un-processes them back into Messages. No schema/version change needed.

Added reLabel() - Round 5's 'RE: [label]' logic: last name(s) from the message's own disclosure, else a business name, else a Political/Commercial heuristic guess. Kept the original extract() unchanged.
senderLabel and senderGroupKey now use AttributionExtractor.reLabel() instead of the old on-behalf-of/number fallback.
SenderCount gained a messages field (that sender's full messages, newest first) so Reports rows can expand to show them.
APP_VERSION ("v1.5") and APP_VERSION_NOTES shown in the new About dialog - versioning convention decided this round: Round N = version 1.N.

Exports the Log and Reports tabs to CSV (via FileProvider + Android's share sheet, no new dependency) - exportLog() and exportReports(), the latter including the action taken per message, not just counts.
Declares the cache/exports/ path used by the new FileProvider for sharing exported CSVs.
Added a FileProvider <provider> entry (authorities com.georgeapp.bulksmsreply.fileprovider) so CSV exports can be shared without broad storage permissions.

New S.R.B. (Stop/Report/Block) tab - lists conversations already processed, with the action(s) taken shown as checkmarked badges, so they can't be accidentally selected and re-processed from Messages.
Conversation rows now always show the RE: label with the phone number underneath; added an About dialog (info icon in the top bar) showing the app version and what changed.
Removed the old 'Read (in this app)' text - a read entry now shows nothing, only unread ones show an Unread tag. Added an Export CSV button.
Report rows are now tappable: expanding a sender shows each full message, any http(s) links as tappable text, and the action taken. Added an Export CSV button next to the period chips.
Added the S.R.B. tab (Messages/S.R.B./Log/Reports order); Messages now excludes any conversation whose latest message is already processed, feeding it to the new S.R.B. tab instead.
versionCode 1->2, versionName 0.1.0->1.5.0, kept in step with AppInfo.kt's APP_VERSION for Round 5.

Added manual label overrides (OVERRIDE_POLITICAL/COMMERCIAL/NONE), wired into reLabel() so a manual choice always wins over the automatic tiers; widened the Political/Commercial keyword lists for better default accuracy.

DB version 2->3: added a label_override table plus setLabelOverride()/labelOverrides(); added markAllRead() for the new 'Mark all read' button; queryLog()/allForReports()/processedConversations() now apply overrides to every entry they return.
Added labelOverride field; senderLabel now passes address + labelOverride into AttributionExtractor.reLabel().
Replaced the single APP_VERSION_NOTES string with a full, retroactive APP_VERSION_HISTORY list (v1.1 through v1.6) so the About dialog shows what every past round added, not just the current one.

Added a per-row label-override menu (Automatic/Political/Commercial/No label, a Sell icon that highlights when set); added a 'Mark all read' button that respects the Unread-only filter; About dialog now scrolls through the full version history.
Passes address + labelOverride into AttributionExtractor.reLabel() so a manual override is reflected on the S.R.B. tab too.
versionCode 2->3, versionName 1.5.0->1.6.0 for Round 6.

This was Claude's sync mistake, not a code defect - the source file already supplied all three parameters correctly.
Re-synced alongside the MainActivity.kt fix above (no content change) purely to guarantee the two files stay a matched pair on Mr. George's PC.

Refactored to call the new shared LabelTagButton instead of its own inline IconButton+DropdownMenu; removed now-unused Sell icon import and the local showLabelMenu state.

Added the LabelTagButton to each S.R.B. row (new onSetLabelOverride parameter on SrbScreen/SrbRow) - fixes Mr. George's "I cannot manually change the label" report: the override control previously existed only on the Messages tab, so it was lost the moment a conversation was processed and moved here.
